title: Claim status update
description: Share a status change on an open insurance claim over WhatsApp: approved, in review or more documents needed. Utility template.
notes: Use a variable for the status instead of writing several templates. Do not promise payout timing the claims team cannot guarantee.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, there is an update on claim *{{claim_no}}*. Current status: *{{status}}*. Open your claim to see details and next steps.
